run_inference_cli: run the inference CLI to generate speech audio from a code file using a HiFi-GAN checkpoint
run_inference_multigpu: run multi-GPU parallel inference to synthesize speech from a dataset of discrete codes
run_inference_debug: run single-GPU debug inference to generate speech audio from one item at a time
load_generator: load a MultiSpkrMultiStyleCodeGenerator model from a checkpoint file onto a specified GPU device
load_vocoder_meta: load speaker and style metadata from text files in the checkpoint directory
